# GNK ASG Network Visuals and Publication Text Pack

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

Prepare photos, graphics, text drafts and portal publication copy for later activation. All materials point back to the portal as the primary source.

## Visual direction

- Corporate colors: dark blue, gold, white, soft silver.
- Style: executive, clear, premium, technology-focused.
- Avoid fake real-life scenes, fake portraits or misleading documentary visuals.
- Use branded cards, abstract business visuals, data dashboards, AI-grid elements, market lines, document icons and global network motifs.
- Each image must have a clear topic, date, GNK ASG mark and `gnk-asg.hr`.

## Required image formats

1. Portal and business network image: 1200 x 630 px.
2. Video thumbnail: 1280 x 720 px.
3. Square public post image: 1080 x 1080 px.
4. Vertical story/reel image draft: 1080 x 1920 px.

## Portal article draft 1

Title: `How Artificial Intelligence Can Improve the Way Users Understand a Corporate Portal`
Category: Technology and AI
Primary entities: GNK ASG, GNK DINAMO Ltd., Nermin Sefic
Recommended visual: Image B1

Summary:
A modern corporate portal should do more than publish pages. It should help visitors understand documents, data, markets, technology and corporate context in a structured way. Artificial intelligence can support this process when it is used as a transparent guide, not as a replacement for official sources.

Opening draft:
Artificial intelligence is becoming most valuable when it improves clarity. For a corporate portal, clarity means that a visitor can understand what is being shown, where the information comes from and how different parts of the public profile are connected. GNK ASG can use AI to connect financial data, market indicators, public documents, technology modules, official information and insight publications into one understandable user journey.

Key points:
- AI should guide users through public data.
- Official documents remain the source of truth.
- The Intelligence Desk should explain where a user can find a document, article or market indicator.
- A structured portal helps third-party users, media, partners and investors.
- The system should clearly separate public facts, editorial analysis and external data.

Closing note:
The strongest corporate portals are not those with the most pages, but those that help users understand what matters and why it matters.

## Portal article draft 2

Title: `Nermin Sefic and the Role of Corporate Transparency in Modern Business Communication`
Category: Governance and Transparency
Primary entities: Nermin Sefic, GNK ASG, GNK DINAMO Ltd.
Recommended visual: Image A1

Summary:
Corporate transparency is not only a reporting function. It is a communication structure that helps third-party users understand a company through documents, data, consistent language and reliable public access.

Opening draft:
The public profile of a business leader is increasingly shaped by the quality of the information framework around the companies he represents. For Nermin Sefic, GNK ASG and the GNK DINAMO Ltd. public content framework, transparency should be presented through structured documents, clear explanations, consistent visuals and accessible public communication.

Key points:
- Search visibility should be built with useful content, not repetition.
- Author pages should connect a person with relevant business topics.
- Public documents should be easy to find and understand.
- Branded images support recognition in search and social previews.
- Clear editorial responsibility improves trust.

Closing note:
A professional public profile is created by consistent, verifiable and useful information over time.

## Portal article draft 3

Title: `Why Official Press Releases Need Structure, Sources and Clear Public Context`
Category: Public Announcements
Primary entities: GNK ASG, Nermin Sefic
Recommended visual: Image B3

Summary:
A press release should make a public announcement easier to verify and understand. It should not overload the reader, and it should not rely on unclear claims. Structure, source references and context make the message stronger.

Opening draft:
An official press release is not only a message. It is a public record of what a company wants readers, journalists, partners and institutions to understand. For that reason, every press release should have a clear subject, a defined source, a stable URL, a concise explanation and a visual identity that connects it to the company’s public information system.

Key points:
- A press release needs one clear subject.
- The source and public context must be visible.
- The headline should be strong but not exaggerated.
- The body should explain what is new and why it matters.
- Social sharing should point back to the official portal page.

Closing note:
Good press communication is precise, verifiable and easy to share without losing context.
